description: This file defines an in-memory repository class for managing session and message data within a chat application, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating sessions, and adding/getting messages.

classes.name: InMemoryRepository
classes.description: A simple in-memory storage class for sessions and messages with methods to create, retrieve, update, and add data.

methods.name: Session create_session(self, user_id: str, context: dict | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a new session with a unique ID, user ID, and optional initial context.

methods.name: Optional[Session] get_session(self, session_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a session by its session ID.

methods.name: Optional[Session] update_session_context(self, session_id: str, new_context: dict)
methods.description: Updates the context of an existing session and refreshes the update timestamp.

methods.name: Message add_message(self, session_id: str, sender: str, content: str, metadata: dict | None = None)
methods.description: Adds a new message to a session, updating the session's timestamp.

methods.name: List[Message] get_messages(self, session_id: str, limit: int | None = None)
methods.description: Retrieves messages for a session, with optional limit for truncation.

ctags.name: add_message
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_message(self, session_id: str, sender: str, content: str, metadata: dict | None = No/
ctags.signature: (self, session_id: str, sender: str, content: str, metadata: dict | None = None)

ctags.name: create_session
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_session(self, user_id: str, context: dict | None = None) -> Session:$/
ctags.signature: (self, user_id: str, context: dict | None = None)

ctags.name: get_messages
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_messages(self, session_id: str, limit: int | None = None) -> List[Message]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, session_id: str, limit: int | None = None)

ctags.name: update_session_context
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_session_context(self, session_id: str, new_context: dict) -> Optional[Session]:$/
